recreation_brief: 1. Set background to light gray (#f0f0f0). 2. Add title 'Neural Network Model' in large bold dark red (#c00000) at top center. 3. Add subtitle '(Weights of Output Layer AFFECTS Calculated Error)' in blue (#0000ff) below title, with AFFECTS in all caps. 4. Place yellow circle with '7' at top right. 5. Add pink 'Input Sample' box at top left. 6. Draw 4 purple input circles on left edge. 7. Add purple circle with '1' and label 'Node Bias' at bottom left of input area. 8. Draw three columns of 3 blue Sigma nodes (with integral symbol) in center. 9. Add yellow 'Net' circles and green 'O' circles (O_i, O_j, O_j) after final column. 10. Label connections with blue 'w_ji' text. 11. Add output labels 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output m' on right. 12. Draw tall red vertical rectangle on right with 'Error' repeated 3 times. 13. Add pink 'Target Label' box at top right with dashed arrow from outputs. 14. Add 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m' labels on far right. 15. Add bottom-left box 'For Layer "j"' with equations Net_j = Σ_i (w_ji O_i) and O_j = f(Net_j) = 1/(1+e^-Net_j). 16. Add 'Previous Layer Layer (i)' box with small 'i' label. 17. Add green 'Current Layer is Output Layer (You are here)' box with small 'j' label. 18. Add right bottom box 'If Layer "j" is Output Layer:' with equation E = 1/2 Σ_j (t_j - O_j)^2.
